faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Aniimo.

items.question: What is the Aniimo release date?
items.answer: Aniimo launches September 16, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC (Steam, Epic, Microsoft Store), iOS, and Android — simultaneously, with no early access.

items.question: Is Aniimo free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Aniimo is a free-to-play creature-catching open-world RPG. Optional Advanced ($9.99) and Collector's ($19.99) editions add cosmetics and companion items.

items.question: How many creatures are in Aniimo?
items.answer: The official Aniilog features 90 Aniimo creatures across 10 elements, plus regional forms and ultra-rare Sparkling variants.

items.question: What is Twining in Aniimo?
items.answer: Twine is Aniimo's signature mechanic — you merge with a captured Aniimo to use its abilities for combat, puzzle-solving, and traversal like gliding, diving, and burrowing.

items.question: Are there Aniimo codes at launch?
items.answer: Aniimo redemption codes are expected from day one. Pre-registration passed 5 million players, unlocking milestone rewards. Bookmark our codes page for daily updates.

items.question: Is Aniimo on Xbox Game Pass?
items.answer: Yes, Aniimo was confirmed as a day-one Xbox Game Pass title, although specific subscriber bonuses have not been announced.
